  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  JUNE 25, 2024

  A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Brock at 4:39 p.m., on
  Tuesday, June 25, 2024, at City Council Chambers, 1685 Main Street, Santa Monica, CA.

  Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Phil Brock
  Mayor Pro Tem Lana Negrete
  Councilmember Gleam Davis
  Councilmember Oscar de la Torre
  Councilmember Jesse Zwick

  Absent:  Councilmember Christine Parra
  Councilmember Caroline Torosis

  Also Present:  City Manager David White
  City Attorney Douglas Sloan
  Acting Clerk Maria Dacanay

  CONVENE/PLEDGE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 4:39 p.m., with
  Councilmembers Parra and Torosis absent. Councilmember Davis led the
  assemblage in the Pledge of Allegiance.

  The Mayor announced that item 3.D. will be heard before 3.C.

  PUBLIC INPUT FOR  Members of the public John Medlin commented on Special Agenda item
  SPECIAL AGENDA  3.B.
  ITEMS ONLY:

  PROCLAMATIONS/  3.A. Commendation: Chinois on Main, was presented to General
  COMMENDATIONS/  Manager Bella Lanstman.
  SPECIAL AGENDA
  ITEMS  3.B. Commendation: Santa Monica Police Department (SMPD)
  Officers Life Saving Medal Commendation, was presented to Officers
  Edgar Arana, Steven Soto, Darnell Crumper and Arash Siah.

  3.D.  City Manager Report, was presented.

  3.C. Proclamation: Gun Violence Awareness Month, was presented to
  Megan Oddsen of Women Against Gun Violence.

  ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the City Council meeting adjourned at 5:04 p.m.
  with Councilmembers Parra and Torosis absent.

  1  June 25, 2024
